en.title: Glass Lungs and the Funeral Procession of the Second Hand
en.premise: I stepped into a clock tower that has been frozen in time, chasing a sound that should not exist. There, the festival night repeats for centuries, and people dance endlessly to the maddening rhythm of the second hand. To obtain a book that records the lost "yesterday" hidden in the underground library, I wander through a labyrinth that spreads within a mirror. Soon I realize that with each breath I take, the very laws of the world creak and begin to collapse.

zh.title: 玻璃之肺与秒针的葬列
zh.premise: 我踏入永远停滞的钟塔，寻找本不该存在的声音。那里，祭典之夜循环数百年，人们在疯狂的秒针节奏中不停舞蹈。为了获得埋藏在地下图书馆中的记录失落“昨日”的书，我在镜中展开的迷宫中徘徊。渐渐地，我发现自己每一次呼吸，世界的法则都在轻微摩擦中崩塌。
